summary: Frontend-only testing of OpenFactura landing integration and dedicated /openfactura page. All required data-testids present and functional. Navigation, external links (href=https://openfactura.es/registro, target=_blank), plans with correct prices (0€, 9,99€, 24,99€, 49,99€), 8 service cards on both landing and page, FAQ accordion (4 items), mobile menu link, footer link, and responsive layout at 390px all verified. Regression checks (public-tab-* x8, header-callback-btn opening callback-dialog) passed. No horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile for either route.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle and Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning in console. Wrap title in VisuallyHidden if intended to be hidden.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Radix DialogContent accessibility: add DialogTitle and aria-describedby/Description to callback-dialog to clear console a11y errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Accessibility: Radix Dialog components used in app are missing required DialogTitle; add VisuallyHidden title to comply with Radix a11y spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All OpenFactura integration testids verified on landing (/) and /openfactura. Only minor Radix Dialog a11y console warnings observed, unrelated to this feature.
